what: Finding 1: Split-path success/cancel calls the Final summary block with new outcomes that are not registered
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed `approved-partition` and `cancelled-decompose` paths would make `render-final-summary.sh` exit with outcome not in enumeration after filing/closing or cancellation, so `/design` would not exit cleanly
suggested_fix: Update the Final summary block contract, `render-final-summary.sh`, and its tests to include the new outcomes, or keep Split-path out of final-summary as the current contract states

what: Finding 3: Partition filing leaves `/larch:issue` LLM dependency analysis enabled, allowing unapproved edges
scenario_or_breakage: The user-approved partition deps can be merged with LLM-proposed `BLOCKED_BY` or `BLOCKS` edges to existing issues or siblings; those edges can silently alter scheduling or cause dep-link failures unrelated to the chosen split
suggested_fix: Invoke `/larch:issue` with `--no-dep-llm` when passing `--intra-batch-deps-file`, mirroring design OOS filing, and add a harness assertion for the exact invocation

what: Finding 5: The Makefile plan says to wire new tests into `lint` instead of the shard aggregate used by the repo
scenario_or_breakage: New `test-decompose-*` targets added as direct `lint` prerequisites but not to a `test-harnesses-N` shard will be reported as unsharded by `test-harness-shards-coverage.sh`, making `make lint` fail
suggested_fix: Add recipes and `.PHONY` entries, then place each new target on one existing `test-harnesses-N` line; only use a carve-out if it is documented in the coverage script, which these normal harnesses should not be

what: Finding 6: Security documentation is omitted for the new public GitHub write and external prompt surfaces
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds dynamic partition issue bodies, a dynamic close-original comment, and a pre-plan external decomposition panel, but only documents one redaction call; maintainers will not see the residual limits around non-secret sensitive content or external reviewer exposure
suggested_fix: Add a `SECURITY.md` note covering decompose-panel external prompts, partition issue body filing via `/larch:issue`, close-original redaction, and residual non-coverage such as internal URLs, PII, and domain-specific sensitive content
